introHtml: Custom recycled mints offer a sustainable way to keep your brand top of mind. Made with recycled materials and packaged in eco-conscious tins like the MicroMints® Domed Tin, these mints are ideal for trade shows, offices, or client gifts. Choose recycled mints to demonstrate your commitment to the environment while providing a refreshing treat that recipients will appreciate.
